Hero_Desc_Mynx:
A fairly experienced werebeast who is in charge of educating young werebeasts.
However, being experienced and teaching are two different things. There are many times when Mynx doesn't know what to teach, so the werebeast students prefer studying on their own.
Album_Like_Mynx: A carefree life, her woodland cottage
Album_Hobby_Mynx: Imagining herself as a respected teacher
Album_Mynx7: Mynx's pupil class is apparently thriving. When asked how she felt, she thanked me and said it must be because she had learned so much from me. She smiled brightly, explaining that teaching her pupils also taught her many things and made every day delightful. Mynx's class will likely remain successful for some time.

how it's done?
Food_ChefNote_Mynx_Hate1: She disliked the unfamiliar texture and flavor compared with raw carrots, especially the strong smell of oil. She can smell oil? Could she perhaps...?
Food_ChefNote_Mynx_Hate2: She once ate one without realizing a real garnet was mixed in and nearly broke a tooth. She has hated them ever since.
Food_ChefNote_Mynx_Like1: She says it is a flavor she wants more of no matter how much she eats. Claiming a house full of it would be wonderfully reassuring, she asked for more.
Food_ChefNote_Mynx_Like2: She praised it as perfect for secretly swallowing in one bite whenever she becomes hungry during training or lessons.
Food_ChefNote_Mynx_Like3: She marveled that one rice cake tastes plain alone, yet blends with everything else into an excellent flavor.
Food_ChefNote_Mynx_Like4: At first she suspected it was firewood, but after one bite, she swiftly finished everything.
Food_ChefNote_Mynx_Like5: She suspiciously tasted a little from her fingertip, declared it good, and ate all of it. She says it restored her energy.
Food_ChefNote_Mynx_Like6: She was amazed that something with a different shape and filling from the rice cakes in soup could still be rice cake.
Food_ChefNote_Mynx_Like7: She says the gentle almond aroma makes it even tastier, with chocolate and almond fragrances mingling in her mouth.
Food_ChefNote_Mynx_Like8: She tried tossing it all into her mouth, but the powder caught in her throat and she coughed it everywhere. Mynx was assigned to clean the banquet hall that day.
Food_ChefNote_Mynx_Like9: She initially refused candy made by a frightening Sprite. After tasting one, she stuffed in the rest at once until her cheeks nearly burst.

LoveLetter_Mynx:
Hello, Master! It is Mynx!

I thought of you while making flyers to recruit pupils, so I wrote this letter. You truly are remarkable. Everyone smiles in front of you. Is it because you feed them? Perhaps I should lure pupils with food too?

But I want to become a teacher of combat, so first I will work hard to gather pupils. Keep doing your best too, Master!
LoveCall_Mynx:
Master, I have decided!
I want to become your pupil! So please become my pupil too!
Neither of us is perfect, and we excel at different things... so surely we have much to learn from one another.
Please be both teacher and pupil with me!

Hmm... Are you surprised? Was my request too forceful?
Perhaps my desire to become a better Werebeast teacher got ahead of me.
Visiting the banquet hall so often has also made you feel much closer to me. Hehe.
Studying and playing together would be so much fun!

In any case, give me your answer when we next meet. I will visit soon!
